sloka: सा हि दिष्टाऽनवद्याङ्गी वनाय वदिरेक्षणे ।अनुगच्चस्व माम् भीरु सह धर्म चरी भव ॥२-३०-४०॥
transliteration: sā hi diṣṭā'navadyāṅgī vanāya vadirekṣaṇe ।anugaccasva mām bhīru saha dharma carī bhava ॥2-30-40॥

translations.english: O one with fascinating eyes and exquisite beauty you were born to live in the forest. O gentle lady, assist me in carrying out my duties.
